idea-plugin.name: Gradle Sync Queue
idea-plugin.description:
Runs Gradle syncs of a project one after another instead of all at once.

When a project links many Gradle builds, IntelliJ IDEA starts a sync for each of them in parallel. Every sync that finds the existing Gradle daemons busy spawns a new one, which can mean dozens of daemons and several gigabytes of memory within seconds. This plugin puts all Gradle model resolution of a project through a FIFO queue, so one daemon is reused for all builds.

  • Works for every sync, including those started by the IDE itself
  • Gradle Queue tool window: queued, running and finished syncs; cancel or release entries
  • Refresh Gradle via Queue in the Project view context menu

action.description: Queue a Gradle refresh for the selected builds
